source.constraint: Classification uses audit metadata only. No proprietary C4Z runtime, documentation, image, or encrypted content was opened, extracted, executed, copied, or used as a specification.

mappingRule: Every exact name in a family's sourceDrivers array inherits that family's primaryClass, wave, prerequisites, and release gates. The 44 arrays contain each of the 142 audited unique driver names exactly once.

classificationDefinitions.generic-control4: Original behavior can be specified from Control4 public SDK/proxy contracts and IntegrateIT requirements without depending on a third-party device protocol. This is not permission to imitate another driver's UX, names, bindings, or implementation.
classificationDefinitions.documented-public-api-protocol-research: A clean-room implementation may be feasible, but coding is blocked until current official vendor/API documentation, terms, authentication rules, rate limits, and redistribution rights are captured in the provenance record.
classificationDefinitions.vendor-authorization-hardware-required: Do not code beyond a protocol-neutral scaffold until the vendor grants or confirms integration rights and representative hardware/accounts are available for acceptance testing.
classificationDefinitions.do-not-republish: The audited artifact is primarily copyrighted/trademarked presentation material or otherwise has no defensible one-to-one clean-room release. Never upload, rename, redraw, trace, or redistribute it.

provenanceGates.name: Reference quarantine
provenanceGates.pass: Third-party packages remain outside source, build, test-fixture, screenshot, documentation, and publication trees; hashes may be retained only in the audit ledger.

provenanceGates.name: Independent specification
provenanceGates.pass: Requirements cite only Control4 public contracts, official vendor materials, IntegrateIT-authored behavior, and black-box observations made on owned hardware where terms permit.

provenanceGates.name: Rights and terms review
provenanceGates.pass: API/protocol access, trademarks, screenshots, icons, names, cloud credentials, and redistribution terms are reviewed and recorded; unclear rights block release.

provenanceGates.name: Original implementation
provenanceGates.pass: Source, XML, documentation, icons, screenshots, binding IDs, and update metadata are IntegrateIT-authored and pass similarity/manual provenance review.

provenanceGates.name: Security and privacy
provenanceGates.pass: Secrets are never logged or packaged; TLS/certificate behavior, token storage, least privilege, redaction, local/cloud data flow, and destructive commands are tested.

provenanceGates.name: Control4 contract verification
provenanceGates.pass: Stable driver UUID/binding IDs, proxy semantics, Composer properties/actions/events, upgrade behavior, and minimum OS claims pass static and controller tests.

provenanceGates.name: Representative hardware acceptance
provenanceGates.pass: Every supported device generation, firmware/API variant, transport, failure mode, and recovery path in the published compatibility matrix has passed on owned lab hardware.

provenanceGates.name: Release truthfulness
provenanceGates.pass: Ops Portal states release maturity, exact compatibility, untested combinations, known limitations, hardware-test status, checksum, version, support path, and rollback instructions.

releaseWaves.purpose: Register provenance-only records and deny publication of all third-party payloads.
exit: P0 passes for all 142 hashes
classification and owner assigned
no third-party binary or asset appears in a release tree

releaseWaves.purpose: Ship the already independent foundation candidates only after their existing code, docs, packaging, portal pages, and regression evidence pass P0-P7.
exit: all automated gates green
real Composer smoke test
honest release-candidate label until controller/hardware evidence exists

releaseWaves.purpose: Build original, device-independent Composer utilities from IntegrateIT requirements and Control4 contracts.
exit: requirements approved without competitor feature matching
destructive/recursive programming guardrails tested
OS 3.3 and current OS controller matrix passes

releaseWaves.purpose: Prioritize integrations that may operate through officially documented local or openly documented device APIs.
exit: official documentation/terms verified at implementation time
owned hardware matrix complete
discovery, auth, rate-limit, reconnect, and firmware-drift tests pass

releaseWaves.purpose: Implement cloud API clients only after cost, consent, data handling, model capability, and credential protections are productized.
exit: official API docs and terms verified
budget/rate controls and redaction tested
